in_marathi.name: Nayantara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the Stars
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nayantara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who gives the Night a Star, or Radiant Night

in_bengali.name: Nayantara
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lady of the Stars
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nayantara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who gives the Night a Star, or Radiant Night

vedic_reference.note: Nayantara is not a direct Vedic name, but it is derived from the Sanskrit words नयन् (new) and तरा (riverbank/shore), meaning 'New/Fresh/Radiant/Glowing One' or 'New/Fresh/Radiant/Glowing Goddess'.
